activity.overview: Use a number line to add and subtract positive and negative numbers in real situations.

problems.prompt: The temperature was -6°F at dawn and rose 11 degrees by noon. What was the temperature at noon?
Compute -8 + 3. Show the jumps on a number line.
Compute -7 - (-12), and rewrite it as an addition problem.
A diver is at -15 meters. She rises 9 meters. Write an addition expression and find her new position.
Explain why 5 + (-5) = 0, using a real situation.

activity.subject: mathematics
activity.title: Moving on the Number Line
